captionEffects.title: Tasirin Rubutun Magana a ByteWave
captionEffects.description: Zaɓi tasirin rubutun magana a ByteWave, duba samfotin motsinsa ka kwatanta Orbital Letters, Supernova da Ember Ash.
captionEffects.lead: Gwada tasiri a kalmominka. Duba shi a kan bidiyonka kafin fitarwa.
captionEffects.step1: Zaɓi rubutun magana a aikin ByteWave naka.
captionEffects.step2: Buɗe tasirin rubutunsa ka zaɓi tsari da aka riga aka saita.
captionEffects.step3: Kunna bidiyonka don ganin tasirin yana motsi.
captionEffects.tip: Gwada gajeriyar jimla ɗaya a kowane tasiri. Daidaita font, girma da launi su dace da bidiyonka.

customFonts.title: Bai Kamata Font Naka Ya Buƙaci Rajistar Kuɗi Ba.
customFonts.description: Shigo da font naka na TTF ko OTF a ByteWave a iPhone. Zaɓi fayil ka yi amfani da My Fonts don tsara rubutun magana kyauta.
customFonts.lead: Kawo font naka a bidiyonka. Shigo da font a ByteWave kyauta ne.
customFonts.step1: Ajiye font na TrueType (.ttf) ko OpenType (.otf) a manhajar Files. Buɗe duk kunshin ZIP da farko.
customFonts.step2: Zaɓi rubutun magana a aikin ByteWave naka ka buɗe faifan Font.
customFonts.step3: Taɓa Import font ka zaɓi fayil ɗin.
customFonts.step4: Nemo shi a ƙarƙashin My Fonts. Taɓa font ɗin don amfani da shi a rubutun maganarka.
customFonts.preview: Kunna bidiyon don duba rubutunka, daidaita girmansa da launinsa, sannan ka fitar.
customFonts.unsupportedHeading: Ba za a iya zaɓar fayil ba?
customFonts.unsupported: Zaɓi ainihin fayil na .ttf ko .otf. Wannan mai shigarwa ba ya tallafa wa font na yanar gizo kamar .woff da .woff2.
customFonts.startPrompt: Kana farawa da aikin da babu komai a ciki?
customFonts.license: ByteWave ba ya karɓar kuɗin shigo da font. Font ɗin kansa na iya samun farashi da lasisi; duba sharuɗɗan mahaliccinsa don amfaninka.
